description: This file defines base classes, data structures, and registration mechanisms for Large Language Model (LLM) services with function calling support. It manages function registration, execution (parallel or sequential), and handles frame processing within an LLM orchestration framework.

classes.name: FunctionCallResultCallback
classes.description: Protocol defining an asynchronous callback for handling the result of an LLM function call.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for invoking a function call, including the function name, arguments, context, and callback.

classes.name: FunctionCallRegistryItem
classes.description: Represents a registered function handler, including metadata such as whether it cancels on interruption.

classes.name: FunctionCallRunnerItem
classes.description: Internal data structure for managing a function call execution within the runner, including context and callback control.

classes.name: LLMService
classes.description: Abstract base class for large language model services, handling registration, execution, and frame processing with support for parallel or sequential execution modes.

methods.name: BaseLLMAdapter get_llm_adapter(self)
methods.description: Returns the LLM adapter instance used for communication with the language model.

methods.name: LLMSpecificMessage create_llm_specific_message(self, message: Any)
methods.description: Creates a language-model-specific message object for use within the LLM context.

methods.name: Optional[str] run_inference(self, context: LLMContext | OpenAILLMContext)
methods.description: Abstract method to run inference with the given LLM context; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Any create_context_aggregator( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
methods.description: Creates a context aggregator for managing conversation context; deprecated and to be replaced.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the LLM service, optionally enabling tracing and setting up sequential execution if configured.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the LLM service gracefully.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels ongoing operations within the LLM service.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, handling specific frame types and interruptions.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Pushes a frame into the processing pipeline, managing TTS skipping when applicable.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions(self, _: InterruptionFrame)
methods.description: Handles interruption frames and cancels function calls that are flagged for cancellation on interruption.

methods.name: register_function( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a handler function for specific or all LLM function calls, with optional start callback and interruption behavior.

methods.name: register_direct_function( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a direct function (metadata auto-extracted) for LLM function calls.

methods.name: unregister_function(self, function_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Removes a registered function handler by name.

methods.name: unregister_direct_function(self, handler: Any)
methods.description: Unregisters a direct function handler.

methods.name: has_function(self, function_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a particular function name is registered.

methods.name: run_function_calls(self, function_calls: Sequence[FunctionCallFromLLM])
methods.description: Executes a list of function calls, either in parallel or sequentially, emitting necessary frames and handling responses.

methods.name: request_image_frame( self, user_id: str, *, function_name: Optional[str] = None, tool_call_id: Optional[str] = None, text_content: Optional[str] = None, video_source: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0, )
methods.description: Requests an image from a user, currently deprecated; use push_frame with UserImageRequestFrame instead.

methods.name: _create_sequential_runner_task(self)
methods.description: Creates a background task for executing queued function calls sequentially.

methods.name: _cancel_sequential_runner_task(self)
methods.description: Cancels the background sequential runner task.

methods.name: _sequential_runner_handler(self)
methods.description: Internal task looping to process queued function calls sequentially.

methods.name: _run_parallel_function_calls(self, runner_items: Sequence[FunctionCallRunnerItem])
methods.description: Runs multiple function call runner items in parallel as asyncio tasks.

methods.name: _run_sequential_function_calls(self, runner_items: Sequence[FunctionCallRunnerItem])
methods.description: Enqueues function call runner items for sequential execution.

methods.name: _call_start_function( self, context: OpenAILLMContext | LLMContext, function_name: str )
methods.description: Invokes the registered start callback for a function, if defined.

methods.name: _run_function_call(self, runner_item: FunctionCallRunnerItem)
methods.description: Internal method to execute a single function call, handle exceptions, and manage callback invocation.

methods.name: _cancel_function_call(self, function_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Cancels ongoing function call tasks matching the specified function name.

methods.name: _function_call_task_finished(self, task: asyncio.Task)
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a function call task to clean up tracking.

methods.name: None __call__( self, result: Any, *, properties: Optional[FunctionCallResultProperties] = None )
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: __init__(self, run_in_parallel: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: function_call_result_callback( result: Any, *, properties: Optional[FunctionCallResultProperties] = None )
methods.description: unavailable
